author: hardcoretiff
name: dotgridshaderoncrack
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Dot Grid style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 6-color palette (#000000, #99FF00, #6600FF, #FF0AEF, #05FF05, #0E06FF). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
